note: Generated asset copies for the Android remote controller (M3). Never edit a destination by hand: run `node tools/sync-remote-assets.js`. `node tools/check-remote-assets.js` fails the build when any copy is missing, stale or extra. See remote/android/README.md.

catalogs.rule: A row means an AUTHORED catalog, under the repo's canonical region-invariant tag. A catalog with no row is fine only when its bytes are a byte-for-byte copy of one that has a row — that is the reported-tag alias `tools/sync-l10n-aliases.js` writes for `vsce` (`l10n/bundle.l10n.zh-cn.json`), which a package run deletes again. Anything else is a new authored language and fails the guard until it has a row here. The rule is content-based on purpose: a list of alias names would rot the moment a language is added, and `tools/check-remote-assets.js` reads no such list. The app canonicalises a reported tag (`zh-cn` -> `zh-Hans`) before it looks a catalog up, so it never needs an alias file.
